output.reason: A 70-year-old on warfarin with head trauma yesterday now reporting bad headache and two episodes of vomiting requires immediate emergency CT imaging for possible intracranial hemorrhage.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now. A head injury while taking warfarin, with a bad headache and vomiting today, can mean bleeding inside the skull that needs urgent CT scanning and possible reversal treatment. Do not drive yourself — have someone take you, or call 911 if you feel drowsy, confused, weak, or your speech or vision changes.
differential: Subdural hematoma from fall on anticoagulation
